questions_and_answers.question: What does 'sono migi no kamera' mean?

answers.answer: the camera to the right of it / that camera on the right

questions_and_answers.question: If a salesclerk points to item X and you want the one above it (position [1]), what do you say?

answers.answer: Sono ue (no) desu. / Sono ue no o misete kudasai.

questions_and_answers.question: If you want the one below the item pointed to (position [4]), what do you say?

answers.answer: Sono shita (no) desu. / Sono shita no o misete kudasai.

questions_and_answers.question: If you want the one to the right of the item (position [3]), what do you say?

answers.answer: Sono migi (no) desu. / Sono migi no o misete kudasai.

questions_and_answers.question: If you want the one to the left of the item (position [2]), what do you say?

answers.answer: Sono hidari (no) desu. / Sono hidari no o misete kudasai.

articles.text:
5. Some expressions that indicate the location of merchandise

When you ask a salesclerk to show you merchandise, you may have to indicate the position of the merchandise, for example, 'the one above it,' 'the one to the right of it' or the like. This can be expressed in Japanese quite easily if we use words like kono 'this,' sono 'that', ano 'that, over there,' particle no 'the one,' migi 'right,' hidari 'left,' ue 'on top,' and shita 'below.' Look at the following:

migi no kamera        the camera on the right
migi no               the one on the right
sono migi no kamera   the camera to the right of it OR that camera on the right
sono migi no          that one to the right of it OR that one on the right

Let us assume a situation like the following: A salesclerk points to some merchandise and you want to see the one to the right/left of it or above/below it. Each position can be shown as follows (X indicates the item the clerk has pointed to):

          [1]
   [2]    X    [3]
          [4]

a. When you want to see the item represented by [1] (above it):
   Sono ue (no) desu.            (It's) the one above it
   Sono ue no o misete kudasai.  Please show me the one above it

b. When you want to see the item represented by [4] (below it):
   Sono shita (no) desu.            (It's) the one below
   Sono shita no o misete kudasai.  Please show me the one below it

c. When you want to see the item represented by [3] (to the right):
   Sono migi (no) desu.            (It's) the one to the right of it
   Sono migi no o misete kudasai.  Please show me the one on the right

d. When you want to see the item represented by [2] (to the left):
   Sono hidari (no) desu.            (It's) the one on the left of it
   Sono hidari no o misete kudasai.  Please show me the one on the left
